name: Tweetbot sandbox critical
description: QA-001 notification-service only; numeric aggregate without notification contents

selectors: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM logs.workersLogs WHERE accountTag = '1657a0cfdeed30e3504b6f86cd9575e8' AND scriptName = 'notification-service' AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '5' MINUTE AND ((attributes['event'] = 'apns_response' AND attributes['status'] = 403) OR attributes['event'] = 'apns_delivery_exhausted' OR attributes['event'] = 'queue_metrics_unavailable' OR (attributes['event'] = 'queue_state' AND attributes['backlog_count'] > 0 AND attributes['oldest_age_seconds'] >= 3300))

name: Tweetbot sandbox http-rate
description: QA-001 notification-service only; numeric aggregate without notification contents

selectors: SELECT if((SUM(attributes['server_error_count']) >= 5 AND SUM(attributes['server_error_count']) / if(COUNT(*) = 0, 1, COUNT(*)) >= 0.05) OR (SUM(attributes['auth_error_count']) >= 20 AND SUM(attributes['auth_error_count']) / if(COUNT(*) = 0, 1, COUNT(*)) >= 0.1) OR (SUM(attributes['throttled_count']) >= 10 AND SUM(attributes['throttled_count']) / if(COUNT(*) = 0, 1, COUNT(*)) >= 0.2), 1, 0) AS value FROM logs.workersLogs WHERE accountTag = '1657a0cfdeed30e3504b6f86cd9575e8' AND scriptName = 'notification-service' AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '5' MINUTE AND attributes['event'] = 'http_request'

name: Tweetbot sandbox apns-rate
description: QA-001 notification-service only; numeric aggregate without notification contents

selectors: SELECT if((SUM(attributes['server_error_count']) >= 5 AND SUM(attributes['server_error_count']) / if(COUNT(*) = 0, 1, COUNT(*)) >= 0.05) OR (SUM(attributes['throttled_count']) >= 5 AND SUM(attributes['throttled_count']) / if(COUNT(*) = 0, 1, COUNT(*)) >= 0.1), 1, 0) AS value FROM logs.workersLogs WHERE accountTag = '1657a0cfdeed30e3504b6f86cd9575e8' AND scriptName = 'notification-service' AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '5' MINUTE AND attributes['event'] = 'apns_response'

name: Tweetbot sandbox queue-heartbeat-missing
description: QA-001 notification-service only; numeric aggregate without notification contents

selectors: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM logs.workersLogs WHERE accountTag = '1657a0cfdeed30e3504b6f86cd9575e8' AND scriptName = 'notification-service' AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '10' MINUTE AND attributes['event'] = 'queue_state'
